displayName: Automatically log off users after inactive interval
description:
Automatically signs out of the Windows App after a period of inactivity. This does not sign the user out of any remote session.

If you enable this policy, specify the inactivity timeout in minutes. After the specified time of inactivity, the Windows App will automatically sign out.

If you disable or do not configure this policy, the Windows App will remain signed in regardless of inactivity.
